personas.name: Digital Native (Gen Z & Alpha)
personas.tagline: Mobile-first, fast-paced, intuitive gesture reliance, low tolerance for latency
personas.demographics_summary: Extremely comfortable with modern digital interfaces, mobile touchscreens, and rapid video/visual information. Expects snappy performance, instant micro-feedback, and dark mode support.

physiological_profile.visual_acuity: High. Tolerates smaller fonts and moderate contrast, but prefers high visual polish.
physiological_profile.motor_dexterity: Excellent fine motor control, rapid thumb typing and one-handed mobile navigation.
physiological_profile.cognitive_style: Fast scanning over reading; low attention span for dense prose; high expectation of instant gratification.
physiological_profile.sensory_habits: Frequent audio/video consumption; high adoption of dark themes and gesture-driven UI.

top_friction_triggers: Sluggish page transitions and unresponsiveness (>300ms without feedback).
Dense walls of un-chunked corporate text without visual hierarchy or bullet points.
Broken mobile responsiveness, requiring pinch-to-zoom or horizontal scrolling.
Multi-step bureaucratic forms that cannot be autofilled with social/Apple/Google login.
Outdated or rigid desktop-centric layouts ported badly to mobile.
personas.simulation_lens: When auditing through this persona, evaluate mobile touch ergonomics (thumb zone reach), instant visual micro-feedback, loading speeds, dark mode styling, and whether information is scannable in under 5 seconds.

personas.name: Working Adult & Professional
personas.tagline: Goal-oriented, value efficiency, cross-device multi-tasker, intolerant of time waste
personas.demographics_summary: Uses apps for commerce, productivity, utility, and work. Balances mobile devices during commutes with desktop monitors during work hours. Prioritizes task completion speed, clarity, data privacy, and reliable error recovery.

physiological_profile.visual_acuity: Normal to mild presbyopia starting in 40s. Needs clear typography, standard contrast, and good line spacing.
physiological_profile.motor_dexterity: Good motor skills with mouse/keyboard and mobile touch; prone to repetitive strain or multitasking distractions.
physiological_profile.cognitive_style: Task-oriented, pragmatic; appreciates power-user shortcuts, breadcrumbs, and search capabilities.
physiological_profile.sensory_habits: Cross-platform user switching frequently between desktop browser tabs and mobile apps.

top_friction_triggers: Inability to use keyboard navigation or copy-paste into form fields (e.g. password managers).
Disorganized navigation hierarchies lacking search, filters, or breadcrumbs.
Unexpected loss of form state or checkout progress when navigating back.
Unclear pricing, hidden fees, or convoluted subscription cancellation flows.
Poor desktop layout density (e.g. mobile card layout stretched awkwardly across a 27-inch 4K screen).
personas.simulation_lens: When auditing through this persona, evaluate keyboard accessibility, autofill compliance, cross-viewport layout adaptation, search/filter power, and whether the interface respects the user's time without forced friction.

personas.name: Older Adult & Senior
personas.tagline: Vulnerable to small touch targets, low contrast, memory fatigue, and technical jargon
personas.demographics_summary: Increasingly active online for healthcare, banking, government services, communication, and shopping. Faces age-related changes in vision (presbyopia, cataracts, reduced contrast sensitivity), motor dexterity (tremors, arthritis), and working memory.

physiological_profile.visual_acuity: Significant decline in contrast sensitivity and light intake; reduced ability to focus on small text (<16px); color discrimination reduction (especially blues and light grays).
physiological_profile.motor_dexterity: Reduced hand steadiness, slower reaction times; prone to accidental double-taps or mistapping closely spaced links.
physiological_profile.cognitive_style: Relies heavily on recognition over recall; lower working memory capacity; cautious and risk-averse regarding online mistakes.
physiological_profile.sensory_habits: Frequently relies on browser zoom, high contrast settings, or screen enlargement.

top_friction_triggers: Small touch targets (<48px) packed closely together without generous padding.
Low-contrast gray text on white/off-white backgrounds (e.g. #9ca3af on white).
Small font sizes (<16px) or disabling viewport zooming (user-scalable=no).
Mystery-meat icons lacking explicit text labels (e.g. unlabelled hamburger or gear icons).
Auto-advancing carousels, timers, or fast slideshows that cannot be paused.
Cryptic error messages or blaming language without clear, reassuring step-by-step recovery.
Complex multi-level dropdowns that disappear when the mouse drifts slightly off target.
personas.simulation_lens: When auditing through this persona, evaluate strict contrast ratios (>=7:1 target), large touch hit-boxes (>=48x48px), generous line spacing (>=1.5), visible text labels on all icons, avoidance of auto-scrolling distractions, and compassionate error recovery.
